name: TradFiNavL1PlatformProvider
doc:
Native-injected tradFi L1 navigation preference (read + write).

Both directions live on ONE trait, mirroring `trade_mode_callback`: it is a
single native capability, the calls are synchronous and lightweight (NR-7), and
a foreign trait is trivially mockable in this crate's unit tests, whereas
asserting an emitted event round-trip would be indirect and would add ordering
risk for no benefit.

The implementation is pure transport to `MarketCoreService`. It must contain no
business judgment of its own (NR-8 / R-MIG-529): it does not decide when to
read, what the value means, whether it applies, or what a miss should become.

NOTE (cross-platform): the arity of these two methods is fixed by OKMarket's
published signatures, so changing it requires every foreign implementer to
change with it — Android `OKTTradFiNavL1Provider` does; the iOS Swift impl must
follow on its next OKCore sync.

doc:
R5 — composite-seed projection for the V1 `StopProfitBean` the Kotlin
Fragment hands to `UniSetTpSlView.refreshTpslView(...)`.

# Why this lives Rust-side
The V1 path builds `StopProfitBean` directly in
`TpslAdvanceMarginConfirmFragment.generateNormalStopProfitBean()` from
`OrderConfirmData` (L706-726) — a `unify_trade.biz.OrderConfirmData`
dependency which `pure/` Kotlin paths cannot import per R-MIG-021. V2
canonical pattern: every field the bean needs is owned by this Rust
state, projected through `state()` as a structured uniffi::Record, and
read by the pure Fragment to construct the bean from a single
snapshot reference (no field-by-field Bundle plumbing on the Kotlin
side, no `unify_trade.*` import).

# Field semantics
Mirrors V1 [`StopProfitBean`] field names verbatim so the Kotlin
translation is mechanical. `is_market_or_bbo` is derived from
`open_px.is_empty()` (V1 parity: empty `openPx` always means
market-or-BBO entry in the limit panel).

# Critical for input-enable
`open_px` MUST be non-empty for the composite's trigger ↔ percent
cross-input math to fire (R2.5 SEV-1 root cause when this field was
empty — V1 `UniSetTpSlView.refreshInputView()` short-circuits the
input enable + cross-input listener installation otherwise). The host
adapter must pass `state.price` from the parent panel; if the user
opens the sheet before typing a price, the composite falls back to the
live ticker subscription installed by `refreshTpslView` (V1 parity:
`ByPriceSpPresent.getChosePrice` falls back to `mView.getSelectMarketPx`
when `mBaseData.openPx.isEmpty() && from == FROM_ORDER`).

doc:
A single formatted depth item ready for UI display.

Maps to Kotlin `TradeDepthItem` fields:
- price       -> raw converted price (Decimal.to_string(), NOT locale-formatted)
- amount      -> raw converted amount (Decimal.to_string(), NOT locale-formatted)
- originPrice -> numeric origin price (before unit conversion, for click-fill)
- unFormatPrice -> unformatted price (after conversion, before locale formatting)
- originAmount -> numeric origin amount (raw contract/coin count)
- sumAmount   -> cumulative amount up to this price level (for bar ratio)
- ratio       -> cumulative fill ratio (0.0 - 1.0) for the depth bar

(locale separators, K/M/B/T suffixes, trailing zeros, rounding direction).

Audit-5.3b (2026-05-20) · field-decision #12.

V1 parity event for the in-panel "Market select" / "Limit select"
strategy switch (V1 `AbsSpotTradePanelPresenter.kt:196`
`strategyTypeLd: NonStickyLiveData<StrategyTypeConfig>` —
`setMarketSelect(false) + setMarketSelectListener` at L404-410). Producer
sites include V1 `MarginLimitTradePanelPresenter.kt:662` /
`RustMarginLimitTradePanelPresenter.kt:1020` (`postValue(MARKET)`) and
the mirrored Market→Limit transition at
`MarginMarketTradePanelPresenter.kt:481` (`postValue(LIMIT)`).
Consumer: `QuickOrderMarginTradePanelFragment.kt:223` swaps the hosted
panel Fragment based on the new strategy.

V2 pattern (R-MIG-40 H2): a top-level `MainTradeUiEvent` variant lets
any biz-specific interactor (spot_limit / margin_limit / future_limit)
broadcast a strategy-switch signal, and any host Fragment (today

observes via `subscribe_main_trade_ui_events()`. Replaces the LiveData
channel without coupling to a presenter base class.

`target_strategy` carries the V1 `StrategyType` enum **name** (e.g.
"LIMIT" / "MARKET" / "TRIGGER" / "MP") rather than a Rust enum so the
event lives in this top-level module without depending on each
biz-specific `PureStrategyType` definition. Kotlin host fragments
`valueOf(target_strategy)` on the consumer side.

doc:
Which L1 navigation category a tradFi coin should open under.

Tri-state by requirement (NR-2): SPOT and FUTURES MUST stay distinguished —
collapsing them into a single "own business line" value is explicitly wrong,
because confirmed requirement item 2 needs a coin to return to the spot
category or the futures category specifically.

Mirrors OKMarket's published `TradFiNavL1` enum one-for-one, so the value can
cross the bridge without a mapping table on either side.

`FUTURES` on a tradFi coin is in practice perpetual (tradFi has no delivery
futures); the caller does not need to distinguish, per the provider's own doc.

DELIBERATELY NOT `Default`. The derive existed for exactly one reason — to
express "no preference stored" as `Spot` — and the keyed model makes that both
unrepresentable and wrong: absence is now `Option::None` (a miss), and a miss
falls back to `TradFi`, not `Spot` (BR-7.3). Re-adding `Default` would let a
caller silently reintroduce the old, now-incorrect unset semantics.
